transcriptionMeaning: Complete accepted chapter-3 leaf inventory with factual paraphrases and exact citations: 26 retained facts, two standalone BESS exclusions. Curated locators are not native engineering project IDs; future-edition continuity requires review.

facts.description: Upgrade the Kenai Tie to 230 kV with larger conductors and voltage-control work between Anchorage and Soldotna.

The source says much physical line construction is complete but few substations are upgraded for 230 kV operation. This does not establish the status of the entire remaining improvement.
